[img]https://img.litet.net/logos/OriginalDescription.png[/img] Allow royalty to do all the work without any class restrictions. Edit to reach the upper royal ranks that are locked. Added 2 Calling Elite Agents with a higher rank.
This is a combined version of the two modes. - Unlock Emperor : https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2457241847 - Working Royalty : https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2457237725
